name: ragfabric-shipped
description: Synthetic Brightwater Analytics corpus, three questions per category. Fixed before any run; never edited to improve a result.

questions.question: How many days of casual leave does an employee get in 2026?
questions.expected_answer: Employees get 10 days of casual leave per year in 2026.

expected_sources.evidence: 10 days of casual leave

questions.question: What is the hotel limit per night for business travel?
questions.expected_answer: The hotel limit is 180 US dollars per night.

expected_sources.evidence: hotel limit is 180 US dollars per night

questions.question: What is the approved budget for Project Beacon?
questions.expected_answer: Project Beacon's approved budget is 260,000 US dollars.

expected_sources.evidence: budget for Project Beacon is 260,000 US dollars

questions.question: Which team owns Project Atlas, and which team must provision its storage cluster?
questions.expected_answer: The Data Platform team owns Project Atlas, and the IT Operations team must provision the new storage cluster.

expected_sources.evidence: owned by the Data Platform team
IT Operations team provisioning the new storage cluster

questions.question: Who maintains the IT on-call rota, and which team does that person belong to?
questions.expected_answer: Ivan Petrov maintains the on-call rota; he is an IT support engineer in the IT Operations team.

expected_sources.evidence: Ivan Petrov maintains the rota
Ivan Petrov is an IT support engineer in the IT Operations team

questions.question: What is the combined approved budget of Project Atlas and Project Beacon?
questions.expected_answer: The combined budget is 680,000 US dollars (420,000 for Atlas plus 260,000 for Beacon).

expected_sources.evidence: budget for Project Atlas is 420,000 US dollars
budget for Project Beacon is 260,000 US dollars

questions.question: Who does the technical lead of Project Atlas report to?
questions.expected_answer: Lucas Moreau, the technical lead of Project Atlas, reports to Aisha Bello.

expected_sources.evidence: Lucas Moreau is the technical lead
Lucas Moreau is a senior engineer in the Data Platform team and reports to Aisha Bello

questions.question: Who is the manager of the person who leads the team that owns Project Beacon?
questions.expected_answer: Project Beacon is owned by the Applied Machine Learning team, led by Kenji Watanabe, who reports to Daniel Reyes.

expected_sources.evidence: owned by the Applied Machine Learning team
Kenji Watanabe leads the Applied Machine Learning team and reports to Daniel Reyes

questions.question: Which product is delayed if Project Atlas slips, and what is that product's code?
questions.expected_answer: Forecast Pro, product code BWA-410, because Project Beacon cannot launch until Project Atlas is complete.

expected_sources.evidence: cannot launch until Project Atlas is complete
sold to customers as the Forecast Pro product
BWA-410

questions.question: How did the casual leave allowance change between the 2025 and 2026 leave policies?
questions.expected_answer: Casual leave rose from 8 days in 2025 to 10 days in 2026.

expected_sources.evidence: 8 days of casual leave
10 days of casual leave

questions.question: How did the rule for carrying forward unused annual leave change from 2025 to 2026?
questions.expected_answer: In 2025 unused annual leave carried forward with no upper limit; from 2026 carry forward is capped at 5 days.

expected_sources.evidence: carried forward into the next year with no upper limit
capped at 5 days

questions.question: Compare the medical certificate rule for sick leave in 2025 and 2026.
questions.expected_answer: In 2025 a certificate was needed for sick leave longer than 2 consecutive days; in 2026 for longer than 3 consecutive days.

expected_sources.evidence: longer than 2 consecutive days
longer than 3 consecutive days

questions.question: Who does Aisha Bello report to?
questions.expected_answer: Aisha Bello reports to Daniel Reyes, the Chief Technology Officer.

expected_sources.evidence: Aisha Bello leads the Data Platform team and reports to Daniel Reyes

questions.question: Which people report directly to Maya Okafor?
questions.expected_answer: Daniel Reyes, Priya Nair and Tomas Lindqvist report directly to Maya Okafor.

expected_sources.evidence: Daniel Reyes is the Chief Technology Officer and reports to Maya Okafor
Priya Nair is the Head of People Operations and reports to Maya Okafor
Tomas Lindqvist is the Chief Financial Officer and reports to Maya Okafor

questions.question: Which team does Sofia Haddad work in, and who leads it?
questions.expected_answer: Sofia Haddad works in the Applied Machine Learning team, led by Kenji Watanabe.

expected_sources.evidence: Sofia Haddad is a machine learning engineer in the Applied Machine Learning team and reports to Kenji Watanabe

questions.question: What does error BW-7731 mean and how is it fixed?
questions.expected_answer: BW-7731 means the nightly warehouse export timed out; rerun the export job with the --resume flag, and page the Data Platform on-call engineer if it fails twice.

expected_sources.evidence: BW-7731: The nightly warehouse export timed out

questions.question: What is error BW-7732?
questions.expected_answer: BW-7732 means the export job could not authenticate to the storage cluster; rotate the service credential in the secrets vault and rerun the job.

expected_sources.evidence: BW-7732: The export job could not authenticate

questions.question: What is product BWA-200 and what does it cost?
questions.expected_answer: BWA-200 is Insight Team, dashboards and scheduled reports for up to 25 users, at 199 US dollars per customer per month.

expected_sources.evidence: BWA-200

questions.question: What is the limit?
questions.expected_answer: The question is ambiguous. Travel limits: meals 60 US dollars a day within the country or 90 abroad, and hotels 180 US dollars per night. Leave: annual leave carry forward is capped at 5 days from 2026.

expected_sources.evidence: daily meal limit is 60 US dollars
capped at 5 days

questions.question: What needs extra approval?
questions.expected_answer: Leave requests longer than 5 working days need People Operations approval; trips longer than 5 days need the director's approval; expense claims later than 30 days need the Chief Financial Officer's approval.

expected_sources.evidence: also need approval from the People Operations team
needs approval from the employee's director
paid only with approval from the Chief Financial Officer

questions.question: How long is it valid for?
questions.expected_answer: The question is ambiguous; the only stated validity period is that VPN device certificates are valid for 365 days.

expected_sources.evidence: certificates are valid for 365 days

questions.question: A customer buys Insight Team with Forecast Pro and pays annually in advance. What is the monthly price after the discount?
questions.expected_answer: Insight Team (199) plus Forecast Pro (350) is 549 US dollars a month; with the 15 percent annual discount it is 466.65 US dollars a month.

expected_sources.evidence: BWA-200
BWA-410
15 percent discount

questions.question: An employee had 9 unused days of annual leave at the end of 2026. How many carry forward into 2027, and how many lapse?
questions.expected_answer: 5 days carry forward and 4 days lapse, because from 2026 carry forward is capped at 5 days.

expected_sources.evidence: capped at 5 days

questions.question: Project Atlas finishes three months late. How much extra double running cost does that add, and which project's launch is pushed back?
questions.expected_answer: About 54,000 US dollars of extra double running cost (3 months at 18,000 a month), and Project Beacon's launch is pushed back because it depends on Atlas.

expected_sources.evidence: 18,000 US dollars per month
cannot launch until Project Atlas is complete
